query: Loading state_dict for LTXAVModel fails with scale_shift_table size mismatches (5,2048 vs 8,2048 etc.) after downloading models from HuggingFace — checkpoint version vs node-pack/model-code version mismatch.

desired.outcome: Maintainer (rluxemburg) states definitive cause: 'This is a checkpoint/code version mismatch. Please check whether you downloaded LTX-2 or LTX-2.3 model weights' — match weight version to the node pack.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
